display.title: Episode 346: The Storyteller, Chapter 9: The Climax (Rosh Chodesh Cheshvan)
display.summary_short: On Rosh Chodesh Cheshvan, Uncle Yossi recalls the lessons of Tishrei, a seven-year-old leads the Shema, and 'The Storyteller' reaches its surprising final chapter.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Rosh Chodesh Cheshvan 5749. Uncle Yossi looks back at the month of Tishrei: when the shofar is blown we crown Hashem as King, and the angels turn our words of prayer into diamonds for His crown; on Simchas Torah we dance with the Torah, thankful to be written in the Book of Life. Tishrei's strength must carry us through the whole year with Torah and mitzvos. After the Hakochainik march and a sponsor message comes the final chapter of 'The Storyteller'. The Baal Shem Tov's sign is revealed: the day someone tells Yitzchak the story of how he returned to his people will be the day his teshuvah is complete. The wealthy merchant listening to Rabbi Yehuda turns out to be that very Yitzchak, and the Baal Shem Tov's blessing of wealth for Rabbi Yehuda comes true. In between, a seven-year-old yeshiva boy leads the Shema. Uncle Yossi then shares a memory of his own parents, who taught him to believe in Moshiach and loved Eretz Yisroel, and plays his father's song 'Uvnei Yerushalayim'. The show ends with the new Tzivos Hashem birthday club and Shabbos candle time.
display.lesson: Tishrei's closeness to Hashem should carry us all year, and it is never too late to come back to Hashem, who arranges everything in wondrous ways.
